title: MSFS 2024 ✈️ 2025 review & roadmap predictions for 2026
description:
What a transformation! 2025 was the year Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 evolved from a rocky launch into the ultimate flight sim platform. In this video, we recap the 4 Major Sim Updates—from the weather revolution to the game-changing Red Bull Air Race mode. 🏁

We’re also breaking down the new aircrafts that "landed" this year (including the Supersonic Boom XB-1! ⚡) and taking a deep dive into the official roadmap. Stick around until the end for my 2026 predictions—could we see even more console expansions?

✈️ What was your favorite update this year? Let me know in the comments!
